_readme: Contact page FAQ. Answers are Markdown. verified:false shows the answer in preview with a 'Needs confirmation' tag and hides it on the live site.

questions.q: Are you a shelter or animal control?
questions.a: No. Bentley's Playhouse is a small Miami-based rescue. Public shelters and animal control, like [Miami-Dade Animal Services](https://www.miamidade.gov/global/animals/home.page), handle strays, lost and found reports and emergencies.

questions.q: I found a dog. Can you take it?
questions.a: We can't promise intake. Our space changes week to week. Please start with [I found a dog](/get-help/found-a-dog/): get the dog scanned and report it to Animal Services, which is required in Miami-Dade. Then [contact us](#msg-h) with photos, the location and what you've done so far, and we'll tell you honestly what we can do.

questions.q: Can you help pay for my dog's vet care?
questions.a: We can't offer funding for vet care. These options may help: [affordable vet care in Miami](/resources/affordable-vet-care-miami/), [RedRover Relief](https://redrover.org/relief/) and [Pet Help Finder](https://www.pethelpfinder.org/).

questions.q: How do I adopt one of your dogs?
questions.a: Start with our [adoption application](https://form.jotform.com/231626654705155). If it's approved, we'll call for a short phone screening, then a home safety inspection, a background check and vetting, and finally the adoption contract. See [Adopt & Foster](/adopt-foster/#our-dogs) for the full steps. Our current dogs are listed on [RescueMe](https://bentleysplayhouse.rescueme.org/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/bentleysplayhouse/).

questions.q: I can't keep my dog anymore. Can you help?
questions.a: We understand this is hard. Contact us and tell us about your dog. We may not have space, but we'll point you to options. Miami-Dade Animal Services also lists alternatives to surrender on its website.

questions.q: Do you answer messages around the clock?
questions.a: No. We're a small team and we reply when we can. If an animal is hurt or in danger, please use the [emergency steps](/get-help/emergency/) instead of waiting for us.
We'll publish our legal and tax information on the Donate page once it's confirmed. Until then, please don't assume a gift is tax-deductible.

questions.q: Is the site available in Spanish?
questions.a: Yes. Every page has a Spanish version: tap "Español" at the top of any page (on phones, it's in the menu).
